# Grounding & Safety Checklist: RBI Notification Intelligence

**Purpose**: Review the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of
grounded-answer, financial-safety, provenance, and local-scope requirements
**Created**: 2026-10-31
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based
on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review
artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the
requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for
requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are the requirements complete for the primary actors (learner,
  researcher, and maintainer) and their distinct responsibilities? [Completeness,
  Spec §User Scenarios & Testing]
- [ ] CHK002 - Does the specification define the required metadata for every accepted
  PDF, tabular dataset, and approved market-condition source? [Completeness, Spec
  §FR-001–FR-003, Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are requirements defined for both supported answers grounded in RBI
  sources and general market education grounded in approved indexed sources?
  [Completeness, Spec §FR-007–FR-008a]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are educational explanations specified for every major concept named
  in scope, including ingestion, topic identification, retrieval, attribution,
  uncertainty, and provider replacement? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are local startup, data persistence, configuration, and failure
  expectations defined without making future deployment targets prerequisites?
  [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions, Spec §SC-011]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 - Is “relevant indexed context” defined with criteria that distinguish
  sufficient evidence from merely similar text? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK007 - Is “sufficiently current” market-condition data defined with an
  explicit freshness rule or reviewer-owned threshold? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-008a,
  Spec §SC-010]
- [ ] CHK008 - Are “material claims” and the minimum citation detail for each claim
  defined consistently across PDF pages, text blocks, tables, rows, and cells?
  [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is the distinction between source fact, derived value, uncertainty,
  and general market education stated in terms that users and reviewers can apply
  consistently? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is “provider replacement” bounded by explicit compatibility
  expectations rather than implying identical wording, ranking, or model behavior?
  [Clarity, Spec §FR-011–FR-012, Spec §Assumptions]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 - Are the no-hallucination, insufficiency, conflict, and degraded-source
  requirements consistent across user scenarios, functional requirements, and answer
  status definitions? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 2, Spec §FR-008, Answer Contract]
- [ ] CHK012 - Do the prohibition on personalized recommendations and the allowance
  for general market education use the same terminology and boundary everywhere?
  [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, Spec §SC-009, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK013 - Are “indexed,” “approved,” “maintainer-approved,” and “source version”
  defined consistently enough to identify which data may support market commentary?
  [Consistency, Spec §FR-008a, Spec §Assumptions, Ingestion Contract]
- [ ] CHK014 - Are the local-only initial scope and future Docker/Kubernetes scope
  consistent across the specification, plan, and quickstart, with no contradictory
  initial acceptance dependency? [Conflict, Spec §SC-011, Plan §Technical Context,
  Quickstart]
- [ ] CHK015 - Do the provider interchangeability requirements align with the stable
  user-facing answer, citation, and learning-explanation contracts? [Consistency,
  Spec §FR-011–FR-013, Answer Contract]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK016 - Can topic and publication-date accuracy be evaluated against a
  reviewer-verified benchmark with an unambiguous denominator and labeling rule?
  [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK017 - Can citation correctness be measured separately from answer relevance
  and wording quality? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, Answer Contract]
- [ ] CHK018 - Is the 100% unsupported-answer abstention target defined with examples
  for insufficient evidence, conflicting evidence, stale data, and unrelated
  questions? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, Spec §SC-009]
- [ ] CHK019 - Are the 30-minute learner outcome and 80% concept-understanding
  outcome tied to a defined learner cohort, task script, and scoring method?
  [Measurability, Spec §SC-004–SC-005]
- [ ] CHK020 - Is the 10-second response target explicitly scoped to a local-machine
  environment and benchmark corpus so it is not mistaken for a universal service
  guarantee? [Clarity, Spec §SC-008, Spec §Assumptions]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK021 - Are primary, alternate, exception, and recovery requirements defined
  for source ingestion, including reprocessing and replacement of a source version?
  [Coverage, Spec §User Story 4, Spec §Edge Cases, Data Model §ExtractionRun]
- [ ] CHK022 - Are requirements defined for questions that combine PDF evidence,
  tabular evidence, and multiple document versions? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009,
  Spec §User Story 2]
- [ ] CHK023 - Are requirements defined for an out-of-corpus question that requests
  market commentary when no approved indexed market source is available?
  [Coverage, Spec §FR-008a, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK024 - Are learner-facing explanations required for abstention, source
  conflict, extraction degradation, and provider unavailability, not only successful
  answers? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK025 - Are maintainer review and corrective-action requirements complete for
  malformed, duplicate, empty, unsupported, and low-quality source inputs?
  [Coverage, Spec §User Story 4, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK026 - Are scanned, table-heavy, multilingual, and unusual-reading-order PDFs
  covered by explicit quality expectations rather than only listed as examples?
  [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK027 - Are missing values, mixed units, inconsistent columns, duplicate rows,
  and conflicting table records governed by explicit preservation or rejection rules?
  [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK028 - Are publication date, reporting month, retrieval date, and source
  replacement semantics distinguished without relying on “latest wins” language?
  [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Data Model §DocumentVersion]
- [ ] CHK029 - Are citation and answer requirements defined for superseded or
  reprocessed sources so historical responses remain auditable? [Recovery, Spec
  §Assumptions, Data Model §SourceArtifact]
- [ ] CHK030 - Are prompt-injection-like instructions in source content explicitly
  excluded from the definition of trusted instructions or evidence? [Security,
  Spec §FR-015, Plan §Constitution Check]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK031 - Are secret handling, sensitive-data minimization, source-content
  exposure, and logging boundaries specified with enough precision to review?
  [Security, Spec §FR-015, Constitution §Core Principles]
- [ ] CHK032 - Are observability requirements defined for ingestion runs, provider
  failures, answer status, citation coverage, and latency without requiring raw
  sensitive content? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016, Constitution §Core Principles]
- [ ] CHK033 - Are reliability expectations defined for partial extraction, failed
  provider calls, unavailable retrieval, and restart or reprocessing scenarios?
  [Coverage, Spec §FR-016, Data Model §ExtractionRun]
- [ ] CHK034 - Are localization and accessibility expectations addressed for the
  localhost learning experience, or explicitly marked out of scope with rationale?
  [Gap, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK035 - Are resource and corpus limits for the localhost target explicit enough
  to interpret the benchmark and avoid implying production-scale availability?
  [Clarity, Spec §SC-008, Spec §Assumptions]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK036 - Are the responsibilities and failure modes of the language-model,
  embedding, retrieval, and vector-store providers documented independently?
  [Dependency, Spec §FR-011–FR-012, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK037 - Is the requirement for maintainer-approved market reports tied to a
  defined approval authority, provenance field, and revocation or supersession rule?
  [Dependency, Spec §FR-008a, Data Model §DocumentVersion]
- [ ] CHK038 - Are the authorized-source and legally-usable-source assumptions
  identified as governance or operational dependencies rather than treated as
  guaranteed facts? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK039 - Are future Docker, Kubernetes, and MCP boundaries explicit about what
  is deferred versus required for the initial localhost feature? [Dependency, Spec
  §Assumptions, Plan §Technical Context]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK040 - Does the specification resolve whether “current market conditions”
  means a defined time window, a source publication date, or a maintainer freshness
  decision? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-008a, Spec §SC-010]
- [ ] CHK041 - Does the specification define how conflicting approved sources are
  surfaced without selecting an unsupported winner? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-008,
  Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK042 - Does the specification distinguish an educational explanation of
  model or workflow stages from disclosure of private chain-of-thought or hidden
  reasoning? [Clarity, Spec §User Story 3, Spec §FR-013]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is
  satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or
  reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify
  markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by
  `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
- This checklist evaluates requirements writing, not application behavior or
  implementation completion.
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy review and traceability.
